# Wave2A.1 actual-algorithm fixture

The two `official/` files are complete Telegram 13.1.2 files from the exact
release pin. Both Git blob SHA-1 and SHA-256 are verified before assembly.

The fixture executes the unchanged production plainText getter, complete
attributed projection and its list-marker helper, and their actual model
declarations for text/run/code/quote/list blocks. Content's envelope, unused
media/table/detail/button payloads and attribute-value objects are explicit
Foundation boundary types. It is not a UIKit/editor, real Postbox or native
rich-text storage test. It deliberately exercises default list-marker mode,
which is the exact mode of the replaced closure.

`oldLiteral` and `newLiteral` are assembled from the actual callback expressions
in the supplied parent and candidate. The projection wrapper counts actual
projection invocations, including recursive quotes; it does not synthesize a
timing result. The history fixture executes both actual filtering sections,
changing `continue loop` only into the equivalent fixture function return.
A counting collection supplies the same first-match operation and records
visits. Duplicate GhostBase attributes test first-match semantics.

Empty/long/Unicode/rich input, custom emoji, links, mentions, spoilers, code,
quotes, off-axis blocks and rapid distinct revisions cover the changed pure
operations. Full source comparison proves all editor guards, setters and other
history branches are unchanged. Existing required native baseline tests run
before the candidate stage; the new fixture runs in both optimization modes
after it. Missing macOS tools fail the required gate.

IME, paste, editing, undo/redo, selection and device latency still require the
actual app/device checks. No FPS, key-to-render or Swiftgram parity claim is
derived from operation counts. No permanent instrumentation is added.
